task_selection.basis: No assignment card exists in comms/inbox for worker-056 at selection time (comms/inbox contains 46 files, none named worker-056). Self-selected ONE bounded class-bound task from the live G-AUDIT unmet list.
task_selection.gap_evidence: research_map/events.jsonl at recon time contains 0 occurrences of 'duplicate_cluster' and 3 events mentioning 'hard_failure_rate'/'kappa' (all three are A0 rubric reviews quoting the criterion, none is a measurement). evaluation_rubric.yaml defines metrics.class_binding, metrics.duplication and review_protocol.independence (kappa, Kish ESS) with targets 1.0 / <=0.25 / >=0.60, and G-AUDIT lists duplicate_cluster_rate, hard_failure_rate, kappa and independent replication as gate criteria. No accepted-stream artifact measures these three metric definitions over the accepted claim/review corpus.
task_selection.one_task_rule: This task measures metric definitions only. It does not adjudicate BL-7, does not issue an A0 rubric verdict, does not issue a gate verdict, and does not write any canonical path.

question: At one hash-pinned snapshot of the accepted stream, what are the A0 metric values (a) class_binding, (b) duplication / duplicate_cluster_rate, and (c) reviewer agreement (kappa, Kish ESS) over the accepted claim and review corpus?
inputs: evaluation_rubric.yaml (A0 rubric, sha256 d748a9e3574e per map; re-measured here)
research_map/schemas.py (event vocabulary; class ids are not read from code)

frozen_definitions.claim_corpus: All events in the pinned events.jsonl snapshot with event_type == 'claim', excluding any event_id present in the pinned rejected.jsonl snapshot (expected exclusion count 0; asserted by control C9).
frozen_definitions.review_corpus: All events in the pinned events.jsonl snapshot with event_type == 'review'.
frozen_definitions.frozen_classes: Exactly four ids parsed from evaluation_rubric.yaml frozen_classes[*].id; control C1 asserts the literal four expected ids and no others.

M1_class_binding.source_metric: evaluation_rubric.yaml metrics.class_binding: 'fraction of claims whose class_id is frozen, singular, and consistent with the evidence metadata and conclusion type'
M1_class_binding.operationalization: tokens = [t.strip() for t in class_id.split(';')]; SINGULAR_FROZEN iff len(tokens)==1 and tokens[0] in frozen_classes; MULTI_FROZEN iff len(tokens)>1 and all tokens frozen; UNKNOWN iff any token not frozen (GLOBAL and empty count UNKNOWN); class_binding = SINGULAR_FROZEN / n. The consistency clause is NOT operationalized here and is declared out of scope (see scope_note).

M2_duplication.source_metric: evaluation_rubric.yaml metrics.duplication: '1 - mean pairwise novelty; novelty(text) = 1 - max shingle Jaccard to any other accepted text'; G-AUDIT duplicate_cluster_rate; HF-07 threshold 0.60
M2_duplication.operationalization: text = claim.statement verbatim; tokens = re.findall('[a-z0-9]+', text.lower()); shingles = set of k=5 consecutive tokens, or the whole token set if fewer than 5 tokens; similarity = |A n B| / |A u B| (0.0 if both empty). max_sim_i = max similarity of claim i to any other claim. duplication = mean(max_sim_i). duplicate_cluster_rate = #{i: max_sim_i > 0.60} / n. Cluster reading: union-find over all pairs with similarity > 0.60; cluster_fraction = (claims in a component of size >= 2) / n.

M3_reviewer_agreement.source_metric: evaluation_rubric.yaml review_protocol.independence ('kappa >= 0.60 on a >= 20% blind sample') and metrics.effective_sample_size ('Kish ESS = (sum w)^2 / sum(w^2) over reviewer/agent labels')
M3_reviewer_agreement.grouping: (target_id, reviewed_sha256 if present else '_NO_HASH_'); a group is multi-review iff it has >= 2 distinct reviewer values.
M3_reviewer_agreement.kappa: Generalized Fleiss over the multi-review groups: P_bar = (1/N) * sum_i (sum_j n_ij^2 - n_i) / (n_i * (n_i - 1)) with N = number of multi-review groups, n_i = raters in group i, n_ij = raters in group i giving verdict j; P_e = sum_j p_j^2 with p_j = pooled category share. kappa = (P_bar - P_e) / (1 - P_e). Categories = {accept, revise, reject, inconclusive}. Reported only if N >= 5 and at least one group has >= 2 categories; otherwise reported as NOT_ESTIMABLE.
M3_reviewer_agreement.kappa_perm: Permutation chance-correction, pre-registered because the review design is sparse: shuffle verdict labels across the pooled rater slots of the multi-review groups (preserving each group's rater count and the pooled verdict multiset) B=2000 times with random.Random(20260912); kappa_perm = (P_bar_obs - mean(P_bar_null)) / (1 - mean(P_bar_null)); z = (P_bar_obs - mean) / sd.
M3_reviewer_agreement.kish_ess: w = 1 per review; ESS = (sum w)^2 / sum(w^2) = n^2 / sum_r n_r^2 over reviewer labels, computed for the whole review corpus and for the multi-review subset. Nominal = number of distinct reviewers.

frozen_definitions.D1_descriptive: Review-recorded hard-failure incidence = #{reviews with non-empty hard_failures} / n_reviews. Explicitly NOT the canonical HF-01..HF-14 detector (that is artifacts/audit/audit_run.py); reported only as context for G-AUDIT hard_failure_rate.

pre_registered_controls.C1: rubric parse yields exactly the 4 expected frozen ids, no more, no fewer.
pre_registered_controls.C2: claim corpus size >= 400 and review corpus size >= 300 (snapshot is not truncated).
pre_registered_controls.C3: positive duplication control: a 20-claim subset with each statement duplicated yields duplication > 0.90 on that subset.
pre_registered_controls.C4: negative duplication control: token-shuffled null corpus (same statements, tokens permuted with seed 20260912) yields duplication < 0.05.
pre_registered_controls.C5: order invariance: reversing corpus order reproduces the identical result_digest.
pre_registered_controls.C6: M3 synthetic: 10 targets x 2 reviewers with identical verdicts -> kappa = 1.0 (within 1e-9); 10 targets x 2 reviewers with seeded independent verdicts -> |kappa| < 0.20.
pre_registered_controls.C7: Kish ESS synthetic: 10 equal reviewers -> ESS = 10.0; one reviewer holding all reviews -> ESS = 1.0.
pre_registered_controls.C8: pin guard: every pinned input sha256 re-measured at end of run equals its start value; fail-closed exit 3 on drift.
pre_registered_controls.C9: exclusion control: a synthetic claim id placed in a rejected-set copy is excluded; the same id absent from the rejected set is included.
pre_registered_controls.C10: fail-closed: a missing snapshot file exits 2 without writing report.json.

exit_codes.2: usage or missing snapshot input; no report written
exit_codes.3: pin drift or control failure; report written with controls.status=FAIL

falsifiers: F1: any published count is not reproduced by re-running run_metrics_census_056.py --check against the same raw snapshots, or two --check runs disagree on result_digest.
F2: any pinned input sha256 moves across the run window without a recorded drift entry.
F3: any of the pre-registered controls C1-C10 does not behave as stated (would refute the instrument, not the target).

F4: an independent re-derivation from the pinned snapshots under the frozen definitions produces a materially different M1/M2/M3 value (definitional divergence must then be reported as a finding, not silently reconciled).

F5: a claim classified SINGULAR_FROZEN whose class_id token list has length != 1, or a claim counted in a >0.60 duplicate cluster whose measured pairwise similarity to the cluster representative is <= 0.60.
F6: D1 is quoted as the canonical A0 hard_failure_rate (category error).
scope_note: Read-only measurement. No canonical path is written: not research_map/*, not schemas/*, not ledger/*, not numerics/*, not reviews/*, not evaluation_rubric.yaml. Worker events cannot set node status=done, validation_status=passed or a gate verdict. The M1 consistency clause, the M3 'blind sample' design property and the BL-7 ledger-scope ruling are out of scope and are reported as not operationalized.
design_reconnaissance_disclosure: Before this file was frozen, only corpus cardinalities were observed while designing the instrument (recon: 562 claim events, 696 review events, 288/696 review events carrying reviewed_sha256). No metric value (M1, M2, M3, D1) was computed before this file was written. Instrument design decisions that depend on those cardinalities: shingle k=5, kappa reported only if N >= 5, B=2000 permutations.
